runs.name: Recon Technology, Ltd; Nasdaq Capital Market RCON, oilfield automation products and software, equipment and accessories, oilfield environmental protection and platform outsourcing services for China's oil and gas producers through PRC subsidiaries and VIEs; a Cayman holding company based in Beijing, a 20-F filer with a June fiscal year; Class A consolidated 1-for-18 2024-05-01 and 1-for-200 2026-08-18; a PIPE 2026-04-10 and an at-the-market program 2026-07-28; Honeywell, Emerson and Rockwell read as the named filing rivals, Schneider Electric and Siemens flagged
runs.box: OUT AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$1.05** (2026-10-15 close, through `tools/sources.py`, aggregator, flagged; closes of $3.34 on 2026-08-18 and $1.25 on 2026-09-15). Shares: 353,154 Class A and 20,000,000 Class B at 2026-06-30 after the 1-for-200 consolidation (20-F FY2026, 0001104659-26-112415, `Screens/cover_shares.py` agreeing); 1,848,443 Class A sold after year-end under the at-the-market program for $8,732,665 gross, Item 7 counting 2,195,938 Class A at the report date; the Class B counted by dividend right at 1/3,600 of a Class A each, 2,201,494 Class A equivalents, a counting choice of the run; no count after the 20-F date, so the count may be low. Sovereign **2.07%** (the 30-year point of the PRC Ministry of Finance China government bond yield curve, 2026-10-15, as hosted at yield.chinabond.com.cn; the protocol's table has no CNY row). RMB at 6.7851 a dollar (the filer's 2026-06-30 rate). `tools/run.py` refused the name (earnings in CNY, quote in USD); every figure taken by hand from the 20-Fs. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 3.D, 4 and 5 (the brief's departure), stated in the run file. Q1 IN (a bid-won supplier of oilfield automation, equipment and wastewater services to CNPC and Sinopec, automation 47.8% of five-year revenue, read off its figures). **Q2 OUT**: a castle shown open: work won by bid ("the Company generally must submit a bid"), CNPC 65% of FY2026 revenue under agreements "each of which is terminable without notice", Sinopec 12%; Item 3.D names larger foreign rivals and "at least five domestic private competitors", "our competitors hold a substantial market share"; an operating loss in every one of twelve fiscal years FY2015 to FY2026 across a full oil cycle, operating expenses above gross profit every year, the one positive net income (FY2022) from a RMB 174.5M warrant revaluation gain; Honeywell, Emerson and Rockwell, named in Item 3.D and SEC filers, earned 8% to 24% net margins in at least ten of eleven years each; Schneider Electric and Siemens named and not SEC filers, the domestic rivals unnamed. FY2026's overseas projects (RMB 44.2M) read as one year, not a full cycle. Q3 to Q12 not reached. **Integrity facts recorded, not judged:** the two founders hold 99.28% of the votes through Class B shares granted as pay, against about 0.5% of the economics, and are the registered owners of the VIEs the company controls by contract; the company borrows RMB 20.0M from a founder while lending RMB 330.0M (52% of assets) to third parties, RMB 262.0M for twenty years at 4.2% to 4.5% to three unnamed companies for an industrial park, 1.6% of short-term principal collected after year-end, interest mostly accrued; loan recoverability a critical audit matter; material weaknesses in internal control; purchase advances RMB 14.6M to 57.8M in a year; Class A shares up about 190 times in 39 months through two consolidations; shares sold at $60 (split-adjusted) in April and about $4.72 in August and September. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: owner cash (operating cash less all capital spending less share pay) negative in all eleven years FY2016 to FY2026, operating cash alone negative every year, five-year average RMB (84.3)M, RMB (68.8)M without the plastic-recycling plant; only the no-growth case can be built; value about **$(214.73)** a Class A share central (about $(264.85) with all capital spending); fair price about **$(40.91) all-equity** ($(41.61) equity-only), no positive price earning the floor; market value about $2.31M below stated net cash of about $9.82M after the share sales, about one year of the FY2026 operating burn of $8.67M; not armed, the box being OUT at Q2. Contamination declared by the analyst: a `Test Runs/` listing filtered for "RCON|recon" before the blind rule was applied in full (a breach of its letter), returning only the IHG run's name, not opened; the OMSE commit subjects in the session context; a memory index line; AYI and ARCB research-folder names in git status; none used; the self-audit's blind-rule box left unticked. Commits 59629c95, f53ea96b, 25ab3051, 1c877055, four. Position note filled at the fold: not held (`PORTFOLIO.md` carries no line for RCON). Citations: the analyst's `check_cites.py` PASS (32 ids, 22 fragments); the dispatcher's `dispatcher_cite_check.py` no phantom, no E-id and no slip among 22 tight pairs; the wider sweep's misses are filing quotations and one quotation of the framework's own Q2 text attributed to Q2. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **A dispatcher's error in the brief:** the brief said the 20-F names no rival by company; Item 3.D names five (Honeywell, Emerson, Rockwell, Schneider Electric, Siemens); the analyst corrected it from the filing. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) Q2's parts threshold breaks when every part loses money, and whether a loan book outside the reported segments is a part (read as one, the file would close TOO HARD at Q1 on the holding-company paragraph); (2) Q7 has no rule for an owner-cash stream negative in every year; (3) no counting rule for a share class whose votes and dividend rights diverge; (4) no CNY sovereign in the protocol's table or `tools/sources.py`, and `tools/run.py` refuses a CNY filer quoted in USD; (5) the brief's statement on named rivals. Could not get: a share count after the 20-F date, the borrowers' names, the at-the-market commission, the rivals' China oilfield lines.
runs.narr: Q2 OUT: a castle shown open; a sub-scale bid-won supplier to CNPC (65% of revenue on agreements terminable without notice) and Sinopec with an operating loss in every one of twelve fiscal years across a full oil cycle, while Honeywell, Emerson and Rockwell, rivals named in its own 20-F, earned 8% to 24% net margins. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: founders with 99.28% of the votes through Class B granted as pay and about 0.5% of the economics, owners of the VIEs; RMB 330.0M, 52% of assets, lent to unnamed borrowers while a founder lends to the company; Class A up about 190 times in 39 months. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: owner cash negative in all eleven years, value and fair price below zero (fair about $(40.91) all-equity, $(41.61) equity-only) against $1.05, not armed. The brief wrongly said the 20-F names no rival; it names five. Framework gaps for the operator: the parts rule when every part loses money and a loan book outside the segments; Q7 with a stream negative every year; split votes and dividend rights; no CNY sovereign or tool path.
